chunks: Better is the Night of Determination than a thousand months.

key_terms.أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ: A thousand months, representing a long period of time (approx. 83 years)
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Decree or Power, a highly virtuous night in Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Laylat al-Qadr being better than a thousand months?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of divine decree (Qadr), where angels and the Spirit (Jibril) descend with God's permission to ordain all matters for the coming year. The 'thousand months' signify not just temporal duration but the cumulative weight of worship across a lifetime, highlighting the night's unique status as a time when the gates of heaven are open and prayers are swiftly answered.
